About the Author关于作者

Anemari Fiser is a tech leadership trainer and coach who helps engineers grow into confident and effective tech leads. With over a decade of experience in the tech industry, she has held roles ranging from software engineer and consultant to tech lead and engineering leader before dedicating her career to developing others.

安内玛丽·菲泽（Anemari Fiser）是一位技术领导力培训师与教练，帮助工程师成长为自信而高效的技术负责人。她在科技行业拥有十余年经验，曾先后担任软件工程师、顾问、技术负责人以及工程领导者等职务，之后将自己的职业生涯全身心投入到培养他人上。

Over the past four years, as an independent professional, Anemari has coached more than 500 engineers and partnered with companies to train nearly 400 tech leads on building high-performing teams, improving communication, and leading with confidence.

在过去四年里，作为一名独立从业者，安内玛丽已辅导了 500 多名工程师，并与多家企业合作，培训了近 400 名技术负责人，内容涵盖打造高绩效团队、改善沟通方式以及自信地带领团队。

She is the creator of O'Reilly's Soft Skills for Tech Leads course and the Level Up as a Tech Lead newsletter, read by 7,000+ tech professionals worldwide. Anemari also shares practical leadership insights with a community of over 30,000 engineers on LinkedIn, where she writes about the real challenges of leading in tech.

她是 O'Reilly《Soft Skills for Tech Leads》课程以及《Level Up as a Tech Lead》通讯的创作者，该通讯在全球拥有 7000 多名技术专业读者。安内玛丽还在 LinkedIn 上与一个超过 3 万名工程师的社群分享实用的领导力见解，撰写关于在科技行业带队所面临真实挑战的文章。

Her practical, people-centered approach helps technical leaders navigate the challenges of leadership while keeping their authenticity—and their sanity—intact.

她务实、以人为本的方法，帮助技术领导者从容应对领导力中的种种挑战，同时保持本色——也保持心智健全。
